spans.quotation: GHG INTENSITY AND METHANE INTENSITY REDUCTION GOALS — Reduce global Scope 1 GHG intensity 10%–15% by year-end 2030, with a near-term, compensation-linked milestone to reduce at least 5% by year-end 2025. — By year-end 2026, reduce APA's global methane intensity by 50% compared to the 2021 baseline year.

Our 1 Million Tonnes GHG Reduction Goal — As part of our 2022 long-term incentive compensation plan, we set a goal for the implementation of projects capable of eliminating at least 1 million tonnes of annualized CO₂e emissions by year-end 2024. We have identified and executed many projects across our operations that will contribute to meeting this goal. We are working with GHD, a third-party consultant, to support our work by verifying project deployment and emissions reduction calculations, providing international operational experience and helping to track our progress on these projects. Through numerous additional projects, most of which are already underway and planned for completion this year, we are on track to meet or exceed this goal.
GHG Emissions Intensity = Scope 1 Emissions (kg CO₂e) / Gross Production (BOE Produced) — Methane Emissions Intensity = Methane Emissions (kg CH₄) / Gross Production (BOE Produced)

note: criteria 1,2,3,4,5 — 5 of 5. Criterion 1 (quantitative): multiple quantified targets — 10%–15% GHG intensity reduction, ≥5% near-term milestone, 50% methane intensity reduction, 1 million tonnes CO₂e annualised project-based goal. Criterion 2 (target-bound): baseline year stated for methane intensity target (2021); target years stated for all targets (2024, 2025, 2026, 2030); GHG intensity target implicitly uses current-period baseline consistent with intensity metric formula. Criterion 3 (methodology): target scope defined as 'global Scope 1 GHG intensity' (operated boundary, consistent with M1 reporting basis); intensity metric formula explicitly defined on p.39 (Scope 1 emissions / BOE produced); GHD third-party consultant named for project verification against 1M tonne goal. Criterion 4 (time horizon): near-term (2025), medium-term (2026), and long-term (2030) target years stated; 'near-term' and implicit long-term labelling reinforces time horizon clarity. Criterion 5 (progress tracking): GHG intensity trend chart on p.39 (30.8→28.4→32.4→30.3→30.5 kg CO₂e/BOE, 2019–2023) and methane intensity trend (0.29→0.25→0.29→0.20→0.18 kg CH₄/BOE, 2019–2023) provide multi-year progress data against intensity targets; 1M tonne goal progress confirmed ('on track to meet or exceed'). coverage_scope: corporate — targets apply to global operated assets. Cross-concept: GHD verification of project-based GHG reductions has partial overlap with F1 (cross-cutting methodology) but the verification is specific to the 1M tonne goal and does not constitute a cross-cutting methodology disclosure across ≥2 concepts; F1 flag not warranted from these spans alone. trend_disclosed = true: 5-year intensity data series available on p.39 chart contextualises target trajectory. assured = false: GHD is named as a project verification consultant for goal-tracking, not as an independent assurer of the target disclosure itself; this does not satisfy the assured attribute condition.
